dataset.name: synthetic (deliberately scoped, not a real-catalog claim)

engine_config.baseline: tantivy::query::TermSetQuery + BooleanQuery (Phase 2's reference TantivyDelegate restriction pattern)

repetitions: 30 measured reps per arm per run, 6 total runs

headline_result.decision_criterion: >=2x mean-latency speedup, same top-10 document set
headline_result.secondary_finding: TermSetQuery/BooleanQuery arm's score is inflated by a constant +1.0 per hit (boolean Must-clause score summing), unrelated to text relevance; bitmap-restrict does not reproduce this (score is exactly the inner query's own score, per a dedicated unit test)
